summary: AB Private Credit Investors Corp filed an 8-K under Item 8.01 to report that its 2026 annual meeting of stockholders was convened and adjourned on August 3, 2026, due to lack of a quorum. No business was conducted. The meeting was rescheduled for September 15, 2026, with the record date unchanged at June 12, 2026, and polls remain open during the adjournment. This is a routine procedural adjournment notice, not a special situation. It does not involve any M&A, activist, tender, restructuring, or other event requiring special-situation classification. The filing is purely administrative and has no deal terms or strategic implications.
